Welcome To Wesley's Moons!

Hello! Welcome to the guidebook for Wesley's Moons. This should help point you in the right direction for getting started and advancing.

Basics

Galetry & Videotapes

In the beginning of the mod, you'd have likely noticed you have currently one moon from the mod unlocked alongside all the vanilla moons. Routing to this moon, Galetry provides access to the beginner moons of the mod. Inside, you'll find the tapes for Motra, Infernis, and Asteroid-13. Bring these tapes up to the projector on the top-most floor, and the tape will play automatically. Take a seat and enjoy the video.

Now that you've watched your tape(s) you'll notice you unlocked the associated moon written on the tape's header side. You can now route there.

NOTE: There is currently a bug in Multiplayer, non-host clients cannot see unlocked moons at the moment. (Fixed?*)

Loggable Items

Across the moons in the mod you'll notice Logs scattered through the map, They look like cassette players. To find these Logs, look for anything that might point you to it, they can tend to be surrounded by investigation equipment like floodlights and flares, if you start seeing tables and papers you are in the right area. These logs can then be carried to the Log Translator and translated into your ship's terminal. This is not the only effect however, in some instances, logs will provide a new route that you didn't previously have, this is not random. every log is set to provide something depending on which log it is.
These logs are not the only translatable item in the previously mentioned Log Translator. You can also log notes you find randomly in the interiors as Scrap.

Progression

Unlike a lot of other moon mods, Wesley's Moons utilizes a roguelike structure for progression.

Note: Some people may not like this system and that's okay; You can disable progression in the Config if desired, otherwise leave it enabled for the intended gameplay.

Without getting into spoiler territory the basic idea is just to go from one moon to the next, collect any loggables you can find, rinse, repeat.

Progression - Moon Connections

If you don't mind spoilers and just want to unlock the moons in order you can find a full image of the progression tree here (Courtesy of WhiteA12, With help from Nagatonis), Log locations can be found on the maps provided in this wiki if help is needed.

Mid-Game

So you've explored a good chunk of moons so far. "What do I do now?" I, Lambda hear you ask across the internet, Well something you might want to consider doing right now is searching for special Apparatuses.. Apparati? Ah Whatever

Mid-Game - Return to Galetry

If you didn't know, near the left-side of the stairs in the back of Galetry there's a Hoarding bug statue you can push, that folds the stairs, and pushes the case back revealing the true inside of Galetry. Don't freak out because its dark or because there's a butler, he's friendly, name's Butch, if you push on and find where the Apparatus slots are, you can turn the lights on. And if you look at the slots, you can see what they'll take. Can you find out where to find them?

NOTE: Yes the stairs CAN kill you.

Mid-Game - What Else?

Before you leave Galetry. You may want to take a right from the ship's door. There's a gift shop you can visit and buy some items.

Your main focus right now is trying to find those special Apparatuses and plug them into the slots in the back of galetry. You don't have to find all of them in one quota, you can take your time, if you plug one into the slot, it will remain there between visits to Galetry, go at your own pace.

The Following moons contain these apparatuses needed to unlock one of the final moons.

  • Demetrica - Bloody Apparatus
  • Cosmocos - Cosmic Apparatus
  • Calist - Royal Apparatus

End-Game

You're approaching the ending! Congrats! This assumes you're at the point you're at the point that you now have access to Hyx

End-Game - Find. That. Tape!

Hyx is a dangerous moon, especially later. staying out of the ship in later parts of the day is essential, that crater in front of the ship is not for decoration.

Navigating Hyx can be really hard especially for your first time, but walking forward from the ship, on the ridge allows you mostly direct access to the facility, you can also walk in the red substance without taking damage of any kind, as dangerous as it looks.

What you're looking for here at Hyx is the Empra Video tape. Which sports a spawn weight of 10, it is not guaranteed to spawn unlike some sources say.

End-Game - Cont'd

Now that you got the tape and watched it back at Galetry, You need a minimum of 2500 credits to go that fancy new moon. Take your time, there's a certain scrap or two you're gonna want:

  • A single normal apparatus, hold on to that
  • A "Huge Harold", Don't question it

End-Game C'D - Return to Sender

Now that you have both of these items, there's a store item you're going to want, hence why I said a "minimum" to route here, You'll want a jetpack. for a total of 3400, not including a discount on the jetpack.

Now that you have all of those, follow these steps, Courtesy of "ChaoticPyre" for writing the following section:

  1. Plug an apparatus to the cart
  2. Place the Huge Harold on the designated slot in the cart
  3. Ride the cart into Empra's plaza
  4. Redirect the mortar
  5. Jetpack to the control tower
  6. Fire the mortar from the control tower NOTE: Make sure every other crewmate is back home at the ship, this step can be fatal, you're safe up there.
  7. Move the crane
  8. Lift the tracks
  9. Ride the cart back home, send it off, jump off, QUICK.
  10. Drive the cart into the overseer and watch the fireworks and the ending cutscene.

Conclusion

Now that you've officially beaten the moons, and watched that hell of a cutscene, you're now in freeplay, do whatever you want, make quotas and explore the other moons. When or if you're fired, you keep all of your moons, so if you get fired at any point you will keep your progress.

Have fun and best of luck.

- Absolute Lambda
